visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a pink button-down shirt over a black t-shirt and grey sweatpants walks through a luxurious building lobby with green velvet chairs and dark marble walls. He suddenly collapses onto the dark floor, lying completely motionless on his side. (2) In a large carpeted banquet hall with gold-covered chairs, a man in a dark grey t-shirt and shorts looks toward the camera before dropping flat onto his stomach on the floor. The setting is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting. (3) A man wearing a bright yellow hoodie, a colorful cap, and sunglasses enters a hotel room with a camera tripod visible. He immediately drops to the carpet and rolls onto his back, mimicking a toy losing its life. (4) The man in the dark grey t-shirt is in a buffet or kitchen area with light-colored walls. He reaches for a counter before falling backward onto the yellow-patterned carpet, lying perfectly still with his arms splayed. (5) A man in an orange t-shirt sits in a restaurant booth eating from a bowl. He abruptly drops his head onto the wooden table, stopping all movement mid-action. The restaurant background is visible with wooden panels and tables.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 3 distinct male figures appearing in sequence.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One man in pink/orange shirts, one man in grey t-shirt, and one man in a yellow hoodie and sunglasses.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice yells "Andy's coming!" with high energy and urgency. Simultaneously, an acoustic guitar and piano start playing a cheerful, bouncy melody at a moderate tempo. (2) A distinct percussive thud follows as a person impacts the floor. The music continues its happy major-key progression as the focal point of the audio track. (3) A different male voice calls out "Xiao Lin, Andy's coming!" in a teasing, playful tone. This is immediately followed by a rustling sound and a soft impact on carpeted flooring. (4) A male voice says "Eh, Andy's coming" with a sharp, surprised inflection. A series of rolling thuds and fabric rustling sounds follow as a body moves across the ground. (5) The phrase "Xiao Lin, Andy's coming" is repeated by a clear male voice. Another loud thud is heard, followed by a faint sound of laughter from the person recording. (6) A short verbal prompt is given over the sounds of a spoon clinking against a bowl. A sharp percussive impact occurs as a head hits a wooden table, and the upbeat music begins to fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To participate in the viral 'Andy's Coming' challenge, where people drop to the floor and act like lifeless toys upon hearing the phrase, referencing the Toy Story movie franchise.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A compilation of clips showing different people reacting to a specific verbal cue by dropping to the floor, edited to an upbeat soundtrack.
